origins.neoorigins.human.name: Mmadụ
origins.neoorigins.human.description: Mmadụ mgbe niile, na-enweghị ikike pụrụ iche kama ọ nwere ikike zuru oke.
origins.neoorigins.merling.name: Merling
origins.neoorigins.merling.description: Ndị mmiri mmiri na-amụ n'oké osimiri mepere emepe - na-eku ume mmiri ma na-egwu mmiri n'ụzọ dị mfe, mana ọ na-eji nwayọọ na-akpọnwụ n'ala kpọrọ nkụ.
origins.neoorigins.avian.name: Abịa
origins.neoorigins.avian.description: Fgbọ elu mara mma nke na-eji nwayọọ nwayọọ na-arịda, na-atụ egwu ọ dịghị elu, wee si n'elu na-ekiri ụwa.
origins.neoorigins.blazeling.name: Na-agba ọkụ
origins.neoorigins.blazeling.description: A mụrụ nke nether ọkụ - scaled na brimstone, weghachiri eweghachi na ọchịchịrị n'ógbè, ma nsi mmiri na mmiri ozuzo.
origins.neoorigins.elytrian.name: Elytrian
origins.neoorigins.elytrian.description: Ọkachamara ụgbọ elu dị ọcha - na-efegharị na mbara igwe, ndị agha kinetic emetụghị ya aka, mana etiti na-emebi emebi na enweghị ike iburu ngwa agha dị arọ.
origins.neoorigins.enderian.name: Endrian
origins.neoorigins.enderian.description: Amụrụ n'agwaetiti dịpụrụ adịpụ nke Ọgwụgwụ - teleports dị ka uche ya si dị, na-ewepụ projectiles n'ime oghere, ma na-eje ije na-adịghị ahụ anya site na endermen. Mmiri na-ere ọkụ dị ka acid.
origins.neoorigins.arachnid.name: Arachnid
origins.neoorigins.arachnid.description: Ududo-mmadụ nke na-atụ mgbidi ọ bụla, na-efegharị webụ na ndị iro, ma na-akụ egbe - ndị ikwu na ndị na-akpụ ụkwụ asatọ nke ụwa.
origins.neoorigins.shulk.name: Shulk
origins.neoorigins.shulk.description: Ejikere dị ka shulker - na-agbapụ ihe otiti, na-alọghachi n'ime shei mgbe agbadoro ya, ma jiri mgbawa levitation malite ndị iro gbagoro elu. Ọ dị nwayọ, mana enweghị ike ịma jijiji.
origins.neoorigins.phantom.name: Egwu
origins.neoorigins.phantom.description: Ihe dị egwu - na-efegharị n'abalị na nku elytra, na-enweta ike site na igbu egbu, mana ìhè anyanwụ na-ere ya ọkụ na enweghị ike izu ike.
power.neoorigins.merling_water_breathing: Na-eku ume n'okpuru mmiri ruo mgbe ebighị ebi ma na-ahụ nke ọma site na mmiri na-enweghị foogu.
power.neoorigins.merling_aquatic_speed.d: Na-eme ọsọ ọsọ mgbe ị na-egwu mmiri.
power.neoorigins.merling_night_vision.de: Na-ahụ nke ọma n'ime omimi gbara ọchịchịrị. Jiri igodo ọhụụ abalị tụgharịa (nke ndabara K).
power.neoorigins.merling_dries_out.name: Na-akpọnwụ
power.neoorigins.merling_dries_out.descr: Ikuku na-ada mgbe ị na-apụ na mmiri: elu dị ogologo karịa ma ị kubie ume. Mmiri ozuzo, ite mmiri, iku ume mmiri ma ọ bụ ọwa mmiri na-arụ ọrụ dị nso na-egbochi ya.
power.neoorigins.avian_no_fall_damage.de: Anaghị emebi mmebi site na ọdịda - nku na-ejide ifufe.
power.neoorigins.avian_slow_fall.name: Ọdịda nwayọ nwayọ
power.neoorigins.avian_slow_fall.descrip: Enwere ike ịgbanwegharị: na-eji nwayọọ nwayọọ na-agbada. Agbanyụrụ na ndabara. Mara: hits dị egwu chọrọ ka ọ daa nke ọma, yabụ hapụ nke a ka ọ dị njọ.
Na-eji 75% obere ume site na omume niile.
power.neoorigins.avian_keen_sight.name: Anya ọma
power.neoorigins.avian_keen_sight.descri: Anya nkọcha - hụ ntakịrị mma n'ọchịchịrị.
power.neoorigins.avian_hollow_bones.name: Ọkpụkpụ oghere
power.neoorigins.avian_hollow_bones.desc: -1 obi (-2 max HP). Ahụ ọkụ, okpokolo agba na-emebi emebi.
power.neoorigins.avian_feather_hop.name: Nku Họp
power.neoorigins.avian_feather_hop.descr: Flutter-malie elu na nku ngwa ngwa. Enweghị ụgwọ agụụ.
power.neoorigins.blazeling_fire_immunity: Na-egbochi ọkụ, lava, magma, na ọkụ - ọkụ dị n'ime na-aza ọkụ na-enweghị.
+ 3 obi (+6 max HP). Efere brimstone na-eme ka ahụ sie ike.
power.neoorigins.blazeling_nether_born.d: Ngwa ngwa n'ala ụlọ - na-aga ngwa ngwa mgbe ọ nọ na Nether (akara ngosi mmetụta a na-ahụ anya).
power.neoorigins.blazeling_stone_fists.d: Aka m na-agbaghị agba na ọkwa nkume-pickaxe - gbajie okwute, ọla na netherrack na-enweghị ngwaọrụ.
power.neoorigins.blazeling_internal_heat: Ọkụ dị n'ime na-ere ọkụ - agụụ na-agbapụta 25% ngwa ngwa.
Mmiri bụ nsi - na-ewe 1.5 mmebi kwa sekọnd mgbe na mmiri ma ọ bụ mmiri ozuzo.
Anya na-ege ntị na infrared - hụ nke ọma n'ọchịchịrị. Jiri igodo ọhụụ abalị tụgharịa (nke ndabara K).
power.neoorigins.blazeling_firebolt.name: Ọkụ ọkụ
power.neoorigins.blazeling_firebolt.desc: Tụgharịa obere bọọlụ ọkụ n'akụkụ ị na-achọ. Na-efu ike 2. 4-nkeji nke abụọ.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_elytra_boost.d: Na-enweta oke ọsọ mgbe ị na-eji elytra malite.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_flight.name: Ụgbọ elu eke
power.neoorigins.elytrian_flight.descrip: Gbanye dị ka onye ọrụ elytra - ọ nweghị ihe achọrọ. Pịa na-awụli elu ka ị na-ada iji gbasaa nku gị.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_flight_speed.d: Ọsọ ụgbọ elu 30% - mbara igwe na-ehulata gị.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_no_fall.name: Ọdịda nku
power.neoorigins.elytrian_no_kinetic.des: Immune ka elytra-nkukota mmebi - ofufe n'ime mgbidi na-enweghị ihe kpatara ya.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_fragile.name: Fragile Fragile
power.neoorigins.elytrian_fragile.descri: Ọkpụkpụ nnụnụ nwere oghere - obi abụọ dị ole max.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_no_heavy_armor: Enweghị ike iburu ngwa agha dị arọ
Enweghị ike iyi ígwè, ọla edo, diamond ma ọ bụ ihe agha netherite - akpụkpọ anụ na chainmail naanị. Nku ga-abụrịrị ìhè.
power.neoorigins.strider_stampede.name: Stampụ
power.neoorigins.strider_stampede.descri: Jikwaa ihu n'ụkwụ ndị siri ike. Na-eri ume 2. 4-nkeji nke abụọ.
power.neoorigins.golem_ground_slam.name: Ala slam
power.neoorigins.golem_ground_slam.descr: Jiri aka ígwè jikwa ụwa daa - mmebi 4 na Slowness II maka sekọnd 4 nye ndị iro niile nọ nso na radius 5-block. Na-eri ume 3. 7-nkeji oyi.
power.neoorigins.enderian_ender_eyes.des: Ndị Endermen na-eleghara anya gị anya - lee ha anya na-akpasughị ọgụ.
power.neoorigins.enderian_projectile_dod: 50% ohere ịpụ na telefon wee zere mmebi mgbe ihe igwe na-akụ ya.
power.neoorigins.enderian_water_damage.d: Na-ewe mmebi 2 kwa nkeji site na kọntaktị na mmiri ma ọ bụ mmiri ozuzo.
power.neoorigins.enderian_teleport.name: Mbugharị Ender
power.neoorigins.enderian_teleport.descr: Teleport gaa n'ebe ị na-achọ - ihe ruru ngọngọ 50. Na-efu ike 2. 3-nkeji oyi.
Jidesie elu ọ bụla kwụ ọtọ - pịa mgbidi ka ijide ya, wulie elu ịrị elu, jide n'aka iji nọrọ ebe ahụ. A na-ezere mmebi ọdịda mgbe ị na-ejide ya.
power.neoorigins.arachnid_cobweb_affinit: Na-aga site na webụs na-enweghị nwayọ ma na-agbaji ya ihe fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ ozugbo.
power.neoorigins.arachnid_entity_group.d: Ọ na-agụ dị ka arthropod - mmebi ọzọ sitere na ngwa agha Bane of Arthropods.
power.neoorigins.arachnid_spiders_fang.d: Mwakpo Melee ịgba nsị - ndị ebumnuche na-ata ahụhụ nsi I maka sekọnd 3.
power.neoorigins.arachnid_cobweb_project: Na-atụba ihe ntanetị nke na-etinye onwe ya na mmetụta, na-emegharị ihe ọ bụla ọ dakwasịrị. Na-efu ike 2.
power.neoorigins.shulk_natural_armor.des: Nguzogide na-adịgide adịgide nke Mbụ - shei ahụ na-amịkọrọ ọnyà ndị ga-agbawa ahụ dị nro.
power.neoorigins.shulk_slow_movement.des: Na-eji nwayọọ nwayọọ karịa ka ọ na-adị.
Na-arụsi ọrụ ike: wepụta mwapu nke shells levitation - ndị iro dị nso na-ese n'elu elu maka sekọnd 3. Na-eri ume 2. 8-nkeji nke abụọ.
power.neoorigins.shulk_shell_retreat.des: Na-arụ ọrụ: pụọ n'ime shei gị wee pụta ihe ruru 12 blocks. Na-eri ume 3. 10-nkeji oyi.
power.neoorigins.shulk_levitation_immuni: Na-egbochi levitation - shei gị na-eme ka ị gbanye mgbọrọgwụ mgbe mgbọ lọghachiri.
power.neoorigins.phantom_night_vision.de: Enwere ike ịhụ nke ọma n'ọchịchịrị zuru oke. Jiri igodo ọhụụ abalị tụgharịa (nke ndabara K).
power.neoorigins.phantom_water_breathing: Ọ dịghị mkpa iku ume. Nwere ike ịdị ndụ ruo mgbe ebighị ebi n'okpuru mmiri.
power.neoorigins.phantom_form.name: Ụdị Phantom
power.neoorigins.phantom_form.descriptio: Na-aghọ ihe a na-adịghị ahụ anya ma na-efegharị n'enweghị ibu.
power.neoorigins.phantom_flight.name: Nku puru iche
power.neoorigins.phantom_flight.descript: Gbanye dị ka onye ọrụ elytra - ọ nweghị ihe achọrọ. Pịa na-awụli elu ka ị na-ada iji gbasaa nku gị.
power.neoorigins.phantom_elytra_boost.de: Na-enweta oke ọsọ mgbe ọ na-ebufe ụgbọ elu - phantoms na-agba nku ha ike.
power.neoorigins.phantom_moon_armor.name: moonplate
power.neoorigins.phantom_moon_armor.desc: Nguzogide m n'okpuru ọnwa (naanị abalị) - ìhè ọnwa na-ekpuchi ụdị ọdịdị ahụ. Ìhè ehihie na-ewepụ ihe nchebe.
power.neoorigins.phantom_soul_drain.name: Mgbapu mkpụrụ obi
power.neoorigins.phantom_soul_drain.desc: Na-agwọ 1 HP oge ọ bụla ị gburu ihe dị ndụ.
power.neoorigins.phantom_no_fall.name: Enweghị ibu
power.neoorigins.phantom_no_fall.descrip: Anaghị emebi ọdịda ọdịda - ahụ mmụọ anaghị ada.
power.neoorigins.phantom_sunburn.name: Ọnwụ anwụ
power.neoorigins.phantom_sunburn.descrip: Na-enweta ọkụ ma na-emebi 1.5 kwa nkeji na ìhè anyanwụ kpọmkwem.
power.neoorigins.phantom_fragile.name: Ụdị Na-emebi emebi
power.neoorigins.phantom_fragile.descrip: -2 obi (-4 max HP). Ahụ alụlụ dị mfe ịchụpụ.
power.neoorigins.phantom_no_sleep.name: Ụjọ anaghị ehi ụra
power.neoorigins.phantom_no_sleep.descri: Enweghị ike ihi ụra - abalị bụ mmewere gị.
origins.neoorigins.feline.name: Feline
origins.neoorigins.feline.description: Nwamba ngwa ngwa nke nwere ọmarịcha ọhụụ abalị na mwụli elu - daa n'ụkwụ ha, na-agafe anụ ọhịa wolf na ocelot, mana na-asọ mmiri asị ma na-ere ọkụ site na ike ngwa ngwa.
power.neoorigins.feline_no_fall_damage.d: Na-agbadata n'enweghị nsogbu. Anaghị emebi ọdịda ọdịda.
power.neoorigins.feline_night_vision.des: Enwere ike ịhụ nke ọma n'ọchịchịrị. Jiri igodo ọhụụ abalị tụgharịa (nke ndabara K).
power.neoorigins.feline_speed_boost.name: Agile
power.neoorigins.feline_speed_boost.desc: Na-eme 10% ngwa ngwa karịa mmadụ nkịtị.
power.neoorigins.feline_mobs_ignore.name: Ụyọkọ Predator
